tips.text: Taeguk refers to the source of everything in the universe
and the universal law in which everything continuously goes through cycles of creation and destruction.
Pumse Taeguk symbolizes the root principle of universal philosophy
and is constructed by applying the truth inherent in Taeguk's yin and yang principles.
Taeguk Samjak stands for Yi of the eight trigrams
and symbolizes fire which represents heat, brightness, and vitality.
Taeguk Samjang is also the last stage of the initiatory training
where you learn to move the center of your body in a stable manner,
achieve harmonious movement of the body, and cultivate dexterity.
We will now take a look at the Pumse of Taeguk Samjang.

and bend the tips a little inward. After making the hand blade as described,
